sloka: त्वरते कार्यकालो मे अहश्चाप्यतिवर्तते ।प्रतिज्ञा च मया दत्ता न स्थातव्यमिहान्त्तरे ॥५-१-१३२॥
transliteration: tvarate kāryakālo me ahaścāpyativartate ।pratijñā ca mayā dattā na sthātavyamihānttare ॥5-1-132॥

translations.english: "My commitment is hastening me. The day set (for the accomplishment of the task) is also drawing to a close. A vow is made and I will not halt in the middle of my work."
